frozen_at: 2026-10-26, before any fresh600 run of these baselines (only 3-task smoke tests); rules/insights learned on label-pool data only
purpose: compare the frozen method (failure-triggered 14B WM repair) with recent-work baselines aligned in model scale, protocol and tasks

alignment.world model / knowledge model: the same frozen Qwen3-14B (wm_alt) for every baseline
alignment.tasks: fresh600 x 3 reps (same task list and reps as the frozen evaluation)
alignment.learning data: label-pool none runs only (448 training-split tasks, disjoint from fresh600 and unseen134)

arms.walle: WALL-E-style one-step MPC: WM judges every proposed action without the valid-action list; Feedback+Suggestion on predicted failure; <=2 revisions; no rules
arms.walle_rules: same + rules learned by learn_walle_rules.py (2 iterations induce/consolidate/prune)
arms.inv_rpms: RPMS-style: same failure gate as the frozen method; verb-relevant rule cards + belief state tracked from observations, rules first; no episodic memory
arms.expel: ExpeL-style insights (learn_expel_insights.py, from the planner's own trajectories) in every planner prompt
arms.inv_expel: same insights shown only at the failure gate

deviations_from_original_methods: WALL-E: rule learning re-implemented in natural language with the 14B model, 2 iterations; one-step MPC with at most 2 revisions
RPMS: hand-written rule cards stand in for its rule base; episodic memory omitted
ExpeL: no retrieval of successful trajectories as extra in-context examples; 4B/14B planners use insights from their own runs
also: non-inferiority of frozen vs each baseline (95% CI lower bound > -2 pp); SR versions; 14B calls and tokens per episode
test: paired task bootstrap 20k on rep-averaged per-task values, two-sided, Holm within each planner's family
